description: During the event, three MoUs were exchanged for the establishment of an AI center. Notably, Abhishek Bose of Microsoft Corporation, Dhruv Kohli of HCL Software, and Shekar Sivasubramanian of Wadhwani AI exchanged MoUs with the UP government.
body_lead: Uttar Pradesh is poised to emerge as a data center hub with Lucknow as a prominent center of Artificial Intelligence (AI). Presently, three data centers are operational in Uttar Pradesh and eight are in the pipeline, said Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Tuesday. Speaking at the ‘Destination UP-Emerging Hub for AI in India’ conclave organised at Indira Gandhi Pratishthan , the Chief Minister said, the UP government is working on developing Lucknow as an AI City, with the active involvement of the youth from IIM Lucknow, he added.
